ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM tool stack burst (ScreenConnect / AnyDesk / Splashtop / Pulseway / Fleetdeck) on freshly-onboarded host
ucs.description: Hunts for the actor's signature post-help-desk-reset playbook: deploying multiple commodity RMM agents on the same victim host within a short window for redundant interactive access. Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest is one of the only crews that routinely stacks 2-4 different commercial RMM tools (per Microsoft / Mandiant / CrowdStrike write-ups) instead of dropping a custom implant.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsBackstageShell.exe","AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","SRService.exe","SRManager.exe","PulsewayAgent.exe","AteraAgent.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","RustDesk.exe","Action1_agent.exe","LogMeIn.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","MeshAgent.exe","dwrcc.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_rmm_tools values(process_name) as rmm_tool_set by dest user | where distinct_rmm_tools >= 2 | stats min(firstTime) as firstSeen max(lastTime) as lastSeen values(rmm_tool_set) as rmm_tools values(parents) as parent_processes values(cmdlines) as cmdlines by dest user distinct_rmm_tools | `security_content_ctime(firstSeen)` | `security_content_ctime(lastSeen)`
ucs.kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsbackstageshell.exe","anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe","srservice.exe","srmanager.exe","pulsewayagent.exe","ateraagent.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rustdesk.exe","action1_agent.exe","logmein.exe","syncro.service.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","meshagent.exe","dwrcc.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(FileName)
| where Img in (RMM)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctRMM = dcount(Img),
            RmmTools   = make_set(Img, 10),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5),
            Parents    = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctRMM >= 2                              // 2+ different RMMs on the same box = Spider tell
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsbackstageshell.exe","anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe","srservice.exe","srmanager.exe","pulsewayagent.exe","ateraagent.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rustdesk.exe","action1_agent.exe","logmein.exe","syncro.service.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","meshagent.exe","dwrcc.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType != "Machine"
| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Img in (RMM)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctRMM = dcount(Img),
            RmmTools   = make_set(Img, 10),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 5),
            Parents    = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
            by Computer, Account
| where DistinctRMM >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider Multi-RMM Tool Stack on Single Host
id: 7b9a2c4e-3d51-4a7b-9c2f-1d8e3f5b6c91
status: experimental
description: Multiple distinct commercial RMM agents executing on the same endpoint within a short window — a Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest hallmark (per Microsoft / Mandiant / CrowdStrike) where the actor stacks ScreenConnect + AnyDesk + Splashtop/Pulseway/Fleetdeck for redundant interactive access after a social-engineered help-desk reset.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.g1015
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rmm:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsBackstageShell.exe'
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer_Service.exe'
      - '\Splashtop-streamer.exe'
      - '\SRService.exe'
      - '\PulsewayAgent.exe'
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_agent.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_commander.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\chisel.exe'
      - '\RustDesk.exe'
      - '\Action1_agent.exe'
      - '\LogMeIn.exe'
      - '\Syncro.Service.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\dwrcc.exe'
  condition: selection_rmm
fields:
  - ComputerName
  - User
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
falsepositives:
  - Managed Service Provider (MSP) hosts that legitimately run multiple RMMs — should be allow-listed by hostname
  - Help-desk technician workstations
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @Image:(*\\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe OR *\\SCREENCONNECT.WINDOWSCLIENT.EXE OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\Splashtop-streamer.exe OR *\\splashtop-streamer.exe OR *\\PulsewayAgent.exe OR *\\pulsewayagent.exe OR *\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\fleetdeck_agent.exe OR *\\fleetdeck_commander.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\NGROK.EXE OR *\\chisel.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\Action1_agent.exe OR *\\MeshAgent.exe OR *\\meshagent.exe OR *\\dwrcc.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(screenconnect\.(windowsclient|clientservice|windowsbackstageshell)|anydesk|teamviewer(_service)?|splashtop-streamer|srservice|srmanager|pulsewayagent|ateraagent|fleetdeck_(agent|commander)|ngrok|chisel|rustdesk|action1_agent|logmein|syncro\.service|tacticalrmm|meshagent|dwrcc)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_rmm), collect([ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| distinct_rmm >= 2
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk MFA reset → attacker-controlled authenticator registration → first sign-in from new geo within 1h
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature initial-access chain: vishing the IT help desk to reset MFA / password for a privileged user, then immediately registering an attacker-owned authenticator and signing in from a residential VPN or new country. This three-event chain (admin reset → self-service security-info registration → successful sign-in from new IP) is the Octo Tempest / 0ktapus playbook documented by Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Okta.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as resetTime from datamodel=Change where (Change.action=modified OR Change.action=updated) (Change.object_category=user OR Change.object_category=identity) (Change.command="Reset user password" OR Change.command="Admin reset password" OR Change.command="Reset password (by admin)") by Change.user Change.src Change.command | rename Change.user as upn Change.src as helpdesk_actor Change.command as reset_action | join type=inner upn [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as mfaRegTime from datamodel=Change where (Change.command="User registered security info" OR Change.command="User registered all required security info" OR Change.command="Admin registered security info" OR Change.command="Add user authentication method") by Change.user | rename Change.user as upn] | where mfaRegTime > resetTime AND mfaRegTime <= resetTime + 14400 | join type=inner upn [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as loginTime values(Authentication.src) as login_src values(Authentication.src_user_agent) as user_agent values(Authentication.app) as app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.signature_id="AAD_Interactive" by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as upn] | where loginTime >= mfaRegTime AND loginTime <= mfaRegTime + 3600 | iplocation login_src | table resetTime mfaRegTime loginTime upn helpdesk_actor reset_action login_src Country user_agent app
ucs.kql:
let Window = 4h;
let PwdResets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("Reset user password.","Change user password.","Reset password (by admin).")
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)),
             HelpDeskActor = tolower(AccountDisplayName)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn, HelpDeskActor, ResetAction = ActionType;
let MfaRegs = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType has_any ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User registered all required security info","Update user.")
    | where RawEventData has_any ("StrongAuthenticationMethod","OTP","PhoneAppNotification","PhoneAppOTP","Microsoft Authenticator")
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name))
    | project MfaRegTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn, MfaIp = IPAddress, MfaCountry = CountryCode, MfaUA = UserAgent;
let Signins = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
    | project LoginTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn, LoginIp = IPAddress, LoginCountry = Country, LoginUA = UserAgent, App = Application, RiskState, ConditionalAccessStatus;
PwdResets
| join kind=inner MfaRegs on TargetUpn
| where MfaRegTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + Window)
| join kind=inner Signins on TargetUpn
| where LoginTime between (MfaRegTime .. MfaRegTime + 1h)
| where LoginIp != MfaIp or LoginCountry != MfaCountry or LoginCountry !in ("US","CA","GB")   // tune to corp geos
| project ResetTime, MfaRegTime, LoginTime, TargetUpn, HelpDeskActor, MfaIp, MfaCountry, LoginIp, LoginCountry, LoginUA, App, RiskState
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 4h;
let PwdResets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Admin reset password","Change user password")
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)),
             HelpDeskActor = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName))
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, HelpDeskActor, OperationName;
let MfaRegs = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OperationName in ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User registered all required security info","User started security info registration")
          or (OperationName == "Update user" and tostring(TargetResources) has_any ("StrongAuthentication","PhoneAppNotification","PhoneAppOTP"))
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)),
             MfaIp = tostring(parse_json(tostring(AdditionalDetails))[0].value)
    | project MfaRegTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, MfaIp, MfaOp = OperationName;
let Signins = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(UserPrincipalName),
             LoginCountry = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, LoginIp = IPAddress, LoginCountry, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
PwdResets
| join kind=inner MfaRegs on TargetUpn
| where MfaRegTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + Window)
| join kind=inner Signins on TargetUpn
| where LoginTime between (MfaRegTime .. MfaRegTime + 1h)
| where LoginCountry !in ("United States","Canada","United Kingdom")     // tune to corp geos
        or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high")
| project ResetTime, MfaRegTime, LoginTime, TargetUpn, HelpDeskActor, MfaIp, LoginIp, LoginCountry, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:("User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "User registered all required security info")) AND -@network.client.geoip.country.iso_code:(US OR CA OR GB) AND @properties.targetResources.userPrincipalName:*
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| EventType=/(passwordReset|securityInfoRegistered|authenticationMethodAdded|mfaRegistered)/i
| groupBy([UserPrincipal], function=[collect([EventType, SourceIp, CountryName, _time], multival=true)])
| length(EventType) >= 2
ucs.rationale: This three-stage chain (admin-driven credential reset → self-service authenticator registration → successful interactive sign-in from a new geo within ~1h) is the documented Octo Tempest / 0ktapus playbook (Microsoft Threat Intelligence Oct-2023, Okta defense advisory, Mandiant UNC3944).
